validation.game.externalPathRequired: Choose the saves folder, or remove the saves location.
validation.game.externalRoleInvalid: SavePoint doesn't recognize that kind of save location.
validation.game.idInvalid: A game ID can use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, and must start with a letter or number.
validation.game.idRequired: This game is missing its ID.
validation.game.installPathRequired: Choose the folder where the game is installed.
validation.game.modsPathRequired: Choose the mods folder, or clear the mods field.
validation.game.pathsNested: The game folder, the mods folder and the saves folder can't be inside each other.
validation.game.schemaVersionUnsupported: This game's file is from a different version of SavePoint.
validation.game.steamAppIdInvalid: Enter the Steam app ID as a number above zero, such as 489830, or leave it empty.
validation.launch.exePathAbsolute: Enter the start file's location relative to the game folder, not a full path.
validation.launch.exePathEscapes: The start file has to be inside the game folder.
validation.launch.exePathRequired: Choose the file that starts the game.
validation.launch.methodInvalid: Choose how SavePoint should start the game.
validation.launch.uriInvalid: That isn't a launch link. It should start with a name and a colon, such as steam://.
validation.launch.uriRequired: Enter the launch link, such as steam://run/123456.
validation.path.invalidCharacter: That folder location has a colon in the wrong place.
validation.path.notAbsolute: Enter the folder's full location, starting from the top of the drive.
validation.path.unknownToken: SavePoint doesn't recognize a name in curly brackets in that location, or it isn't on this computer.
validation.profile.branchNameInvalid: This profile's internal name can use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores and single slashes, but can't start with a hyphen or slash or end with a slash.
validation.profile.branchNameRequired: This profile is missing its internal name.
validation.profile.gameIdRequired: This profile isn't linked to a game.
validation.profile.idRequired: This profile is missing its ID.
validation.settings.accentColorInvalid: Pick one of the accent colors from the list.
validation.settings.layoutInvalid: Pick the Sidebar or the Library layout.
validation.settings.storageRootRequired: Choose a folder for your snapshots.
validation.settings.themeInvalid: Pick Light, Dark, or the theme that matches your system.
